description: This file defines the LocaleConfigManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing configuration translations, overrides, and synchronization with locale storage, specifically handling interface translation updates and language-specific configuration data.

classes.name: LocaleConfigManager
classes.description: Manages configuration supported in part by interface translation, handling translation updates, overrides, and synchronization with locale storage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for configuration, locale storage, language management, and default config storage.

methods.name: getTranslatableDefaultConfig
methods.description: Retrieves translatable default configuration data for a given configuration name.

methods.name: getTranslatableData
methods.description: Extracts translatable strings from a typed configuration element, wrapping them in TranslatableMarkup.

methods.name: processTranslatableData
methods.description: Processes translatable data array for a specific language, returning translated or source strings.

methods.name: saveTranslationOverride
methods.description: Saves configuration override data for a specific language.

methods.name: saveTranslationActive
methods.description: Saves active configuration data with translations merged.

methods.name: deleteTranslationOverride
methods.description: Deletes configuration override for a specific language.

methods.name: getComponentNames
methods.description: Retrieves configuration names associated with specified components or all if none specified.

methods.name: getStringNames
methods.description: Retrieves configuration names associated with specific string identifiers.

methods.name: deleteLanguageTranslations
methods.description: Deletes all configuration translations for a given language code.

methods.name: translateString
methods.description: Translates a string from English to a target language, caching translations for efficiency.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the static cache of translations.

methods.name: getStringTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a translation object for a specific string, context, and language.

methods.name: hasTranslation
methods.description: Checks if a configuration has translation for a specific language.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigLangcode
methods.description: Returns the original language code of shipped configuration, defaulting to 'en'.

methods.name: getActiveConfigLangcode
methods.description: Returns the current language code of active configuration.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a configuration is supported for interface translation (default language is English).

methods.name: isUpdatingTranslationsFromLocale
methods.description: Indicates if configuration translations are currently being updated from locale.

methods.name: updateConfigTranslations
methods.description: Updates configuration translations for specified configuration names and languages.

methods.name: filterOverride
methods.description: Filters override data to only include keys present in default translatable configuration.

methods.name: updateDefaultConfigLangcodes
methods.description: Updates default configuration language codes when the site default language changes.
